Indexes.label: Control Strength Index
Indexes.note: Computed over 70% of the specified signal weight; missing signals are listed in the coverage gaps.

Indexes.label: Incident Pressure Index
Indexes.note: 2 eligible incidents; raw pressure 0.075 squashed with k = 3.0. Counts one underlying event once; media volume is the separate attention index.

Indexes.label: Uncertainty Score
Indexes.note: Weighted mean of coverage gap, external-forecast disagreement, low-tier evidence share, judgment share, sensitivity spread and the calibration gap (1 until proxy calibration exists). Not a probability.

Indexes.label: Agentic Infrastructure Risk Index
Indexes.scale: 0–100, higher = more exposure from agent infrastructure

Indexes.label: Attention Index
Indexes.note: Not computed: the prototype ingests no media-volume data. Article counts are never used as incident counts.
